policy.fallback: Render the full nickname when any approval is absent, pending, revoked, or invalid.
policy.publicationBasisNote: Owner-authorized public-profile portrait is a scoped directory-owner publication decision and must not be represented as individual consent.
policy.certificatePublicationBasisNote: Filled certificate images use the separate owner_authorized_public_certificate gate. QR targets are excluded from public data and contribution evidence.
policy.socialPreviewPublicationBasisNote: The social-preview photograph uses a separate owner_authorized_social_preview_image decision and is not approved for profile, brand, favicon, certificate, or other roles.
policy.heroPublicationBasisNote: The hero photograph and decorative motif have separate, role-scoped owner approvals. Neither asset is approved as a person portrait, header identity, favicon, certificate, or substitute brand mark.
